A 50yrs old female c/o fever, vomiting, burning micturition,SOB

November 28, 2022
This is an online E log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his/her/guardian's signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs. This E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box.

Chief Complaints:
C/O Fever since 10days, Burning micturition since 10days, vomitings since 10days (5-6 episodes),Grade 3 SOB since 10days

History of Present Illness:
Patient is apparently asymptomatic 10days back then she noticed fever low grade,continuous type not associated with chills and rigors
H/o vomiting non projectile,non bilious,food as content
C/o SOB Grade 3 since 3days
C/o burning micturition after foleys insertion at local hospital

History of Past illness:
H/o hypertension since 2months (on regular medication)
No h/o DM,Asthma, epilepsy,TB,CAD

Personal History:
Married
Occupation: daily wage labour
Diet:mixed
Appetite:normal
Bowel movements: regular
No drug allergy

Family History:
No h/o DM, Asthma, Hypertension,TB,CAD, Epilepsy in the family

Menstrual history:
Menopause:20years back

General Examination:

Vitals:
Temp: Afibrile
Respiratory rate:24bpm
Pulse:86bpm
Blood pressure:130/90mmhg
Sp O2:96

Systemic Examination:

Cardiovascular Examination:
Thrills:No
Cardiac sounds:S1,S2 sounds 
Cardiac murmurs:No

Respiratory system:

Position of trachea:central
Breath sounds: vesicular
Adventitious sounds:no
Wheeze:no
Dysponea:no

Abdomen

Shape of abdomen: scaphoid
Tenderness:not tender
Palpable mass:no
Henias orifices: normal
Free fluid:no
Bruits:yes
 
Liver:not palpable
Spleen:not palpable
Bowel sounds:yes

Central Nervous system:

 Pt is conscious
Speech: normal
Signs of meningitis:no
Cranial nerves: normal
Motor and sensory system:normal

Provisional Diagnosis:
CRF

Investigation:


Treatment:
Tab.NICARDIA 10mg PO BD
Tab.NODOSIS 50Pmg PO BD
Tab.LASIX 40mg PO BD
Tab.OROFEX XT PO OD
Tab.SHELCAL PO OD
Inj.ERYTHROPOITEIN IV Weekly once
